'''Damelle daugher of [[Ala]] daughter of [[Soferra]]''' was an [[Ogier]] [[author]].

==History==
Damelle once wrote a book about the [[Ways]]. In it, she describes how a [[Waygate]] in the [[Great Blight]] was destroyed. It took thirteen [[Aes Sedai]] using a ''[[sa'angreal]]'' to accomplish it. [[Loial]] tells [[Perrin Aybara]] about Damelle and her book when Perrin asks the Ogier to destroy the Waygate in the [[Two Rivers]].{{ref/book|4|43}}
